Il polmone è la sede più frequente delle:
The lung is the most frequent site of metastases of renal carcinoma (about half of metastatic patients). Hematogenous metastases are multiple, round, well-defined nodules of different sizes, more numerous in the peripheral and basal fields; very large ones are called "cannonball". Other typical sites: lymph nodes, bone (lytic), liver, adrenal gland, brain, pancreas.
In staging of renal carcinoma, chest CT is always necessary; for the nodules, the lung kernel and window and thin images should be used.
For management: the metastatic patient is a candidate for systemic therapy (combination immunotherapy); cytoreductive nephrectomy is considered in selected cases.
